front.title: First iPhone Duo unboxing video surfaces ahead of Friday launch
front.tldr: A leaked unboxing video shows Apple's iPhone Duo in hand for the first time, two days before its Friday launch.

front.title: SpaceX's AI business is beating expectations
front.tldr: SpaceX posted third-quarter net income of $4.4 billion, with its AI business the main driver of the profit, the company said.

front.title: David Fincher cut 60 pages from Tarantino's 'Cliff Booth' script
front.tldr: Fincher cut 60 pages from Quentin Tarantino's script for 'The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth,' the Once Upon a Time in Hollywood follow-up starring Brad Pitt, saying it was essentially two movies.

stories.title: OpenAI acquires Orchestra Bio
stories.tldr: OpenAI is acquiring Orchestra Bio to bring AI-powered operations to life sciences research, aiming to help biopharma teams speed up drug development.

stories.title: Google joins Amazon in taking on Nvidia with new AI developer tool
stories.tldr: Google has released a developer tool, following Amazon, that makes it easier for PyTorch users to move their AI apps off Nvidia GPUs.

stories.title: Physical AI is in its 'LEGO era', says ex-Nvidia VC
stories.tldr: Former Nvidia executive turned VC Amulya Vishwanath says physical AI, robots that act in the real world, is at an early, LEGO-like stage, ahead of its own ChatGPT moment.

stories.title: Franchisee cuts repricing time 95% with ChatGPT Work
stories.tldr: A Schlotzsky's and Cinnabon franchisee used ChatGPT Work to cut menu repricing time by 95% and build a workflow that could free up $100,000 in cash flow.

stories.title: SpaceX and Tesla boards form special committees to review merger
stories.tldr: SpaceX and Tesla's boards have formed special committees of independent directors to review a potential merger. Elon Musk said he likes the idea but sits on neither committee.

stories.title: The next Xbox might cost $1,800, report says
stories.tldr: Microsoft is targeting a 2028 release for its next Xbox, which could cost as much as $1,800, according to a profile of the company's Xbox CEO.

stories.title: Streaming guide JustWatch becomes a streamer itself
stories.tldr: JustWatch, the streaming search guide used by 50 million people, is launching its own service: a free, ad-supported tier alongside a $3.99-a-month ad-free option.

stories.title: SpaceX alum's aviation startup Reliable Robotics tops $1B valuation
stories.tldr: Reliable Robotics, an aviation startup founded by a SpaceX alum, raised $115 million in equity plus $25 million in debt, pushing its valuation past $1 billion.

stories.title: This startup built an AI model to decipher what plants are saying
stories.tldr: Startup Electric Plant has built an AI translator that listens to the subtle electrical signals running through plant stems, aiming to decode what they are saying.

stories.title: Apple announces American Manufacturing Program partners for latest iPhone lineup
stories.tldr: Apple announced new and expanded partnerships with American companies supplying materials and components for the iPhone Duo and iPhone 18 Pro.

stories.title: Skyrim comes to Apple Silicon Macs with new unofficial installer
stories.tldr: A new unofficial installer brings Bethesda's 'The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim' to Apple Silicon Macs for the first time, 15 years after its original release.

stories.title: Apple's App Store chief explains its push for premium games
stories.tldr: More premium games are launching on the App Store this year than last, Apple's App Store head Carson Oliver told Polygon, including more franchises moving over from PC and consoles.

stories.title: iPad mini 8 expected next week with these new features
stories.tldr: MacRumors reports that Apple plans to unveil an OLED iPad mini 8 next week, with attendees at its October 28 Los Angeles event expected to get hands-on time.

stories.title: 'Whalefall' director and star resisted the new ending before embracing it
stories.tldr: 'Whalefall' director Brian Duffield and star Austin Abrams were initially hesitant about the film's new ending, which was added after test screenings.

stories.title: Julia Stiles cries during Heath Ledger tribute on 'Dancing with the Stars'
stories.tldr: Julia Stiles paid tribute to the late Heath Ledger on 'Dancing with the Stars', performing a contemporary routine with her partner to mark Dedication Night.

stories.title: Lance Oppenheim bribed Robert Pattinson with 200 Zyn canisters to star in 'Primetime'
stories.tldr: Robert Pattinson agreed to play Chris Hansen in 'Primetime' after director Lance Oppenheim bribed him with 200 canisters of Zyn. The film chronicles 'To Catch a Predator.'

stories.title: 'Wildwood' review: Laika's stop-motion wonder lacks its studio's usual magic
stories.tldr: IndieWire's review says Laika's stop-motion film 'Wildwood' avoids the worst trends in mainstream animation but loses its way between reality and imagination.

stories.title: Celtics collapse, lose season opener to Pistons 121-113
stories.tldr: The Celtics led the Pistons by 22 points in the second half of their season opener, then collapsed to lose 121-113 in Detroit.

stories.title: It's not so #DifferentHere after all without Jaylen Brown
stories.tldr: Paul George hit his third straight three-pointer to give the Celtics a 72-50 lead in the third quarter of his debut, before Boston's collapse in the fourth.

stories.title: Patriots power rankings: win streak sends message from the mess
stories.tldr: Experts' power rankings now have the Patriots climbing from irrelevance back toward credible contender status after their recent win streak.

stories.title: FIA imposes new rules on F1 teams to stop cost cap exploitation
stories.tldr: The FIA will stop F1 personnel sharing office space or communal areas with a team's non-F1 staff, part of a wider clampdown on cost cap exploitation.

stories.title: Five talking points for the United States Grand Prix
stories.tldr: Andrea Kimi Antonelli could clinch the championship as early as this weekend's United States Grand Prix in Austin, one of several storylines heading into the race.

stories.title: Formula 1's move to shorter grands prix in 2027 will not be permanent
stories.tldr: The FIA has confirmed that Formula 1 will reinstate full grand prix distances in 2028, after shortening races for the 2027 season.

stories.title: The moments that made the 2026 Red Sox: one lucky night in August
stories.tldr: A wild 3-2 walk-off win over the Giants in August may have been the turning point of the Red Sox's season, Over the Monster argues in its look back.

stories.title: Red Sox report cards: Boston's pitching corps earns higher marks
stories.tldr: Boston.com's season report cards give the Red Sox starting rotation, strengthened by several newcomers, its highest marks of the summer.

finally.title: Astronomers identify the first green star
finally.tldr: Astronomers have identified the first green star, a white dwarf that turned a ghostly shade of chartreuse after swallowing rocky debris from a shattered planet.
